cheats.name: Fly Mode
cheats.note: Player.IsDebugFlying returns m_debugFly (+0x978) for the local owner with no cheat gate; Player.InDebugFlyMode returns it directly. Character.UpdateDebugFly consumes it through a virtual call, not traced. Not run in-game.

cheats.name: Ghost Mode (enemies ignore you)
cheats.note: Player.InGhostMode returns m_ghostMode (+0x97A). The enemy AI is expected to call it through a virtual call; no direct caller found in BaseAI/MonsterAI targeting methods. Not run in-game.
